repairs.proof_term:
fun m n => by
  change (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) (n + 1), (k + m)) = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) n, (k + m)) + ((n + 1) + m)
  rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (f := fun k => k + m) (by omega)]
repairs.replaces_proof_term:
fun m n => by
  dsimp
  rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (f := fun k => k + m) (by omega)]

repairs.proof_term:
fun m n => by
  intro h_double h_sub h_ih
  calc
    (2 : ℕ) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) (n + 1), (k + m))
        = (2 : ℕ) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) n, (k + m)) + (2 : ℕ) * ((n + 1) + m) := h_double
    _ = ((((2 : ℕ) * m) * n) + (n * (n + 1))) + (2 : ℕ) * ((n + 1) + m) := by rw [h_ih]
    _ = (((((2 : ℕ) * m) * n) + (n * (n + 1))) + ((2 : ℕ) * (n + 1))) + ((2 : ℕ) * m) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← h_ih]
      exact h_sub
repairs.replaces_proof_term:
fun m n => by
  intro h_double h_sub h_ih
  calc
    (2 : ℕ) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + 1), (k + m))
        = (2 : ℕ) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (k + m)) + (2 : ℕ) * ((n + 1) + m) := h_double
    _ = ((((2 : ℕ) * m) * n) + (n * (n + 1))) + (2 : ℕ) * ((n + 1) + m) := by rw [h_ih]
    _ = (((((2 : ℕ) * m) * n) + (n * (n + 1))) + ((2 : ℕ) * (n + 1))) + ((2 : ℕ) * m) := by
      rw [← h_ih]
      exact h_sub
